comparison.objective: Separate finishing media from washers, versus spacing parcels on a moving conveyor before scanning.
comparison.physical_skill: Orientation-dependent sifting and bimanual load sharing versus time-critical parcel repositioning on a moving belt.
comparison.success_condition: At least 98% media recovery with all washers retained and no loss versus two specified inter-parcel gaps while parcels remain on the belt.
comparison.reason: Conveyor singulation does not test aperture-based separation or granular bridge clearing.
